categories.label: Speech editing
categories.description: Change spoken dialogue while preserving the scene.

categories.label: Subject editing
categories.description: Change the subject’s appearance while preserving the scene.

categories.label: Background editing
categories.description: Change the setting while preserving the foreground subject.

categories.label: Subject addition
categories.description: Add a subject to the source scene.

categories.label: Subject removal
categories.description: Remove a subject while retaining the background.

examples.title: A jellyfish bloom
examples.instruction: Replace the character's dialogue with: "A massive jellyfish bloom has completely overtaken the coastal waters now." while maintaining all visual elements and background sounds identical to the original scene.

examples.title: A downtown mural
examples.instruction: Adjust the character's dialogue to: "The city's top muralist just finished a stunning new downtown mural." while maintaining all visual elements and background sounds identical to the original scene.

examples.title: Bartender attire
examples.instruction: Replace the individual's attire with standard bartender clothing including a white shirt, black vest, and dark apron while preserving all gestures, expressions, and scene details.

examples.title: Racing suit
examples.instruction: Replace the subject's dark brown T-shirt with a race car driver's branded fire-resistant racing suit while preserving all other visual elements like background, lighting, and physical posture.

examples.title: Desert ranch
examples.instruction: Replace the background with a sunny desert ranch setting, while keeping the person, clothing, headwear, expression, and camera trajectory in the foreground consistent.

examples.title: Art-filled park
examples.instruction: Replace the background with an upscale, art-filled park, with snow-capped mountains in the distance, while keeping the person in the foreground exactly the same in appearance, clothing, tie, and serious expression.

examples.title: A futuristic interior
examples.instruction: Insert a person with blue hair, facial markings, and a black leather jacket into the futuristic interior background while maintaining the original camera movement and lighting.

examples.title: A man on the phone
examples.instruction: Place a man with curly hair in a gray sweater over a light blue shirt holding a cell phone into the scene, with audible human speech, while keeping the staircase, flowers, and framed artwork as they are.

examples.title: Remove the man
examples.instruction: Remove the white-haired man in the center of the screen from the original video, keeping the blurry wooden clothes hanger in the background.

examples.title: Remove the woman
examples.instruction: Remove the woman with blood on her face in the center of the screen from the original video, keeping the blurry hotel environment in the background.
